data.desc: Deep Fission is developing technology that places a small modular pressurized water reactor in a borehole approximately one mile underground. The Company's Gravity Nuclear Reactor approach combines established pressurized water reactor technology with a novel underground deployment model designed to simplify construction, enhance safety, and support scalable commercial deployment. Deep Fission is focused on delivering reliable, low-carbon baseload power to meet growing electricity demand from utilities, industrial customers, and data centers. The Company is currently advancing the development of its first reactor project in Parsons, Kansas, and was selected for the U.S. Department of Energy's Reactor Pilot Program.
